title: Triple integrals and solid coordinate systems
terms: triple integral; volume element; spherical volume element; cylindrical volume element.

exposition.text:
A triple integral sums a density over a solid. Fubini’s theorem permits iterated integration for
continuous functions on compact regular solids, and more generally for integrable functions;
Tonelli’s theorem permits nonnegative integrands even before finiteness is known. In cylindrical
coordinates dV = r dr dθ dz. With polar angle ϕ measured from the positive z-axis, spherical
2
coordinates give dV = ρ sin ϕ dρ dϕ dθ.
Derive bounds from the solid before manipulating the integrand. Sphere-cone intersections
are usually spherical; vertical cylinders are usually cylindrical. The coordinate system changes
the volume element, not merely the formula for the function. Symmetry makes odd integrands
integrate to zero over regions symmetric in the relevant coordinate.

solution.text:
This tetrahedron has coordinate intercepts 2, 3, 4, so its volume is one sixth of their prod-
uct: 2 · 3 · 4/6 = 4. Equivalently, scaling the standard simplex contributes Jacobian 24 to its
